drake.definition:
n. English explorer and admiral who was the first Englishman to circumnavigate the globe and who helped to defeat the Spanish Armada (1540-1596)
n. adult male of a wild or domestic duck

drakensberg.translation: 德拉肯斯堡山脉[非洲东南部](即夸特兰巴山脉)

drakes.definition:
n. English explorer and admiral who was the first Englishman to circumnavigate the globe and who helped to defeat the Spanish Armada (1540-1596)
n. adult male of a wild or domestic duck
drakes.translation: n. 公鸭, 蜉蝣类( drake的复数形式 )

drakestone.definition:
n. A flat stone so thrown along the surface of water as to
   skip from point to point before it sinks; also, the sport of so
   throwing stones; -- sometimes called ducks and drakes.
drakestone.translation: n. (玩打水漂游戏用的)石片
